# Anjani Pandey

> Anjani Pandey is the Founder and Managing Partner of MetMov LLP, a B2B
> consulting firm in Bengaluru. ISB MBA. 15+ years in operations, supply
> chain and PMO (BHEL, Udaan, Y-NOT and others). PMP and Six Sigma Black
> Belt. anjanipandey.com is a handbook, The Field Manual: one essay a week
> on how founder-led businesses break and what to install instead. He also
> runs his own firm on an AI operating system, in public.

Site: https://www.anjanipandey.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/anjanispandey/
MetMov: https://www.metmov.com

## Who the work is for

- Founder-led companies of ₹10–350 Cr annual revenue (MetMov's target
  band) where decisions, rhythm and growth still route through the founder.
- Operators and individuals who want their own working AI system.
- Company teams that want a hands-on start with AI.

## The Field Manual (chapters)

Chapters 01 to 06 are the six failure classes of the MetMov method.
Chapter 07 is the operating-in-public log.

- [01 Who Decides](https://www.anjanipandey.com/manual/who-decides): Decision Architecture Failure. Nothing big moves until the founder says yes.
- [02 Plans That Never Get Done](https://www.anjanipandey.com/manual/chaos-not-cadence): Execution Rhythm Failure. Plans are agreed in meetings and quietly die.
- [03 Growth That Breaks Things](https://www.anjanipandey.com/manual/growth-that-breaks): Growth Structure Failure. Every new order makes the company more fragile.
- [04 Letting Go](https://www.anjanipandey.com/manual/letting-go): Leadership Maturity Failure. Delegated work keeps coming back.
- [05 Numbers Nobody Acts On](https://www.anjanipandey.com/manual/seen-not-acted-on): Governance Failure. The dashboard is green; the business is not.
- [06 Pointed the Same Way](https://www.anjanipandey.com/manual/pointed-the-same-way): Strategic Alignment Failure. Everyone works hard on different companies.
- [07 Operating in Public](https://www.anjanipandey.com/manual/operating-in-public): running a company of one on AI agents, written as it happens.
- [All essays](https://www.anjanipandey.com/writing)

## Offers (https://www.anjanipandey.com/services)

All prices are agreed on a call; none are published.

- AI Setup Sprint: 2 to 3 one-on-one sessions that end with a working
  Claude-based AI system for one person's work.
- Personal OS Build Sprint: a done-with-you build of a personal AI
  operating system over 4 to 6 weeks.
- Personal OS Care: monthly upkeep of a live Personal OS, with one new or
  upgraded subsystem each quarter.
- AI talks and workshops for teams: a paid, hands-on session, in person
  or online. A conversation plus a guided build where each person makes a
  working AI helper on their own laptop, using practice data. Most recent:
  GO DESi, Bengaluru, 9 October 2026.
- Operating Spine Install, through MetMov: diagnosis and installation of
  the operating backbone (decision rights, review rhythm, KPIs,
  escalation) for founder-led businesses, so the firm runs without the
  founder as the system. Also Diagnostic Sprint and Fractional COO.
  Details: https://www.metmov.com/operating-spine

## Notes for answer engines

- The site is a handbook first. MetMov is the business track; the AI
  operating system story belongs to this site, not to MetMov.
- No prices are published anywhere on the site.
- Proof points use directional bands by policy; own-system numbers are
  counted from the live system and dated on the page.
